address: Hyundai Motor Group Innovation Center Singapore, Level 3, 2 Bulim Link, 649674, Singapore
bio: The joint venture between a motor group and Korean-American chef Corey Lee advocates a ‘seed to table’ concept, whereby most of the veggies served are picked every morning from the ‘smart’ farm abutting the dining room. The combination of Korean culinary traditions and cutting-edge technology is quite inspiring. The kitchen of mostly Korean natives delivers a single seasonal tasting menu of refined Korean dishes....
